evidence_scopes: Original summary phase accounting is referenced, not recomputed into a new performance verdict.
CPU deltas cover a slightly wider observation envelope than engine wall; CPU time can include active CUDA waiting/driver work.
sched_schedstats was disabled; small recorded runqueue deltas cannot establish absence of host interference.
Host apply contains route/ensure/map/sum spans; host_uncovered is the remaining host apply envelope. CUDA load spans overlap host work and are never added to wall.
GC values are exact callback interval intersections with engine-call windows, retained without subtracting them from performance.

GPU samples are sparse and do not contain per-kernel durations or continuous SM clocks. Cgroup windows are wider than the call windows; excess cgroup usage is not directly attributed to a foreign process.
remaining_unlocated: Most D/R repeat drift is CPU-accounted engine time, spread across multiple calls and across both measured MoE host envelopes and engine time outside those envelopes. Existing fields cannot name a specific timer, Python function, kernel dispatch, CUDA polling wait, or hardware contention source.
next_smallest_action: If one further isolation is run, use the unchanged admit2_32 workload/policy as A/A and capture one host stack/API profile of the common old-wait segment (calls 4-15), retaining complete wall and an unprofiled control. Do not add another scheduler parameter or report profiler time as a corrected performance result.
